adjudication.rationale: In app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb, poll_feed does `content = CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` inside `rss.items.each`. If a feed item lacks `content` (i.content is nil), calling `.scrub` will raise NoMethodError and abort the whole job mid-loop; there is no per-item rescue. The job is configured with `sidekiq_options retry: false`, so failures won’t retry automatically.
